description: The compiler derives a type from an initializer, a return statement or a default value, so no annotation is needed.
A function expression gets its parameter types from where it is used, e.g. the callback passed to `map` or `reduce`.
For array literals the compiler unions the element types: `[1, 'a']` becomes `(string | number)[]`.
`const list = []` starts as `any[]` and changes type with every `push`. Annotate empty arrays to lock the element type.
